description: Skeleton calibration fixture set for editorial-moments. Each clip points at a short video file plus per-moment-type human-rated scores in [0, 1]. Real video files are NOT checked in — populate clip_path with paths on a labeler's local disk (or a corpus mount) before running scripts/calibrate.py.
